slides.title: The Swedish long weekend
slides.body:
When a holiday falls on a Thursday, the Friday becomes a *klämdag*. Take it off and you get four days in a row.

Some workplaces close for it completely.

slides.en: I'm off on the squeeze day.

caption:
Klämdag: a squeeze day. It's a working day stuck between a public holiday and the weekend, and many people take it off.

Ascension Day is always on a Thursday, so the Friday after it is the classic klämdag.

Would you take the klämdag off?
